hlg_c1bb6cd286703481_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to browse farmer-provided product offers, select and specify product quantities while respecting minimum order constraints, submit orders for validation, and receive automated order summaries via email, while also allowing them to view product origin details and optional crop characteristics including certifications and ripeness.
hlg_c1bb6cd286703481_001.rationale: llg_001 enables viewing product origin details including certifications and availability; llg_002 enables browsing farmer-provided product offers with pricing and availability windows; llg_003 enables selecting products and specifying quantities while enforcing minimum order constraints; llg_004 enables submitting orders and triggering system validation of constraints; llg_005 enables receiving automated email summaries post-submission; llg_006 enables viewing optional crop characteristics such as size, ripeness, and certifications. All these capabilities are distinct and must be preserved without generalization or omission.

hlg_91b57471207e9b44_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to submit, modify, confirm, and receive notifications for order changes due to insufficient availability, while enforcing minimum quantity requirements.
hlg_91b57471207e9b44_001.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to submit orders with minimum quantity constraints; llg_002 allows modification of existing orders by altering quantities or items; llg_003 triggers confirmation and system validation upon finalization; llg_004 introduces a distinct capability to notify customers of availability-driven changes and provide API-based acceptance/rejection options — this capability is materially different and must be explicitly included to expose the scope mismatch.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Submit an order with minimum quantity
Notify customer of order changes due to insufficient availability

hlg_1c190ea7f86685cf_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to monitor wallet balances, receive payment notifications, manage insufficient funds with grace periods, recharge wallets via in-store terminals or online transfers, and support partial payments for orders.
hlg_1c190ea7f86685cf_001.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to check wallet balance and payment status, which supports awareness of fund availability. llg_002 enables real-time payment notifications, enhancing transparency. llg_003 introduces a grace period for insufficient balance, allowing customers to avoid immediate order cancellation. llg_004 enables wallet recharging via in-store terminals, supporting physical access to funding. llg_005 enables wallet recharging via online transfer, supporting digital funding methods. llg_006 introduces partial payment support for orders, enabling flexible payment structures. Together, these capabilities form a comprehensive wallet and payment management system with multiple funding and notification pathways, including a grace period and installment support.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Check wallet balance and payment status
Handle insufficient balance with grace period

hlg_45d7b64c9eb54357_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable customers to schedule, be notified about, and handle consequences of product pickup appointments at physical stores.
hlg_45d7b64c9eb54357_001.rationale: llg_001 enables customers to select a pickup time slot based on store availability; llg_002 ensures customers receive a reminder notification before pickup to confirm attendance; llg_003 ensures customers are notified if they miss pickup and are informed of forfeit policy consequences — together, these cover the full lifecycle of a pickup appointment including scheduling, notification, and consequence management.

hlg_d7aace6841b88a6b_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable farmers to submit, update, and confirm product availability estimates for dynamic allocation and order fulfillment, with real-time updates and a Monday-morning confirmation deadline.
hlg_d7aace6841b88a6b_001.rationale: llg_001 enables initial submission of product availability estimates for dynamic allocation; llg_002 adds real-time update capability via API to reflect stock or delivery changes; llg_003 introduces a mandatory Monday-morning confirmation of final quantities available for order, which is a distinct lifecycle phase and deadline not covered by the other goals.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Confirm final product quantities available for order

hlg_5c82e14395e9d14b_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement a dynamic customer prioritization system during shortages that calculates, updates, and displays a fair-play score based on order behavior, enabling automated prioritization of customer orders and transparent visibility of priority status.
hlg_5c82e14395e9d14b_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to automatically prioritize customer orders during shortages using a fair-play score. llg_002 adds the capability for customers to view their fair-play score to understand their priority level. llg_003 adds the capability to calculate and update the fair-play score based on completed orders, reminders, or penalties via API. Together, these form a complete system: score calculation and update (llg_003), score visibility (llg_002), and automated prioritization during shortages (llg_001).
source_low_level_goal_ids: Prioritize customer based on fair-play score

hlg_d714bbf6da86e761_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable store employees to manage end-to-end order fulfillment, including coordination of product pickup, processing customer payments, and confirming delivery status via system updates.
hlg_d714bbf6da86e761_001.rationale: llg_001 enables store employees to view and manage pending orders for fulfillment; llg_002 adds the capability to coordinate pickup logistics including time and location; llg_003 introduces payment processing and wallet balance updates via system API; llg_004 adds the capability to confirm delivery status and update system records. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of order fulfillment from initiation to delivery confirmation, with explicit handling of pickup logistics and payment integration.

hlg_c12fcb1e0bd72453_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Notify stakeholders of delivery delays, automatically credit back missing amounts with 20% bonus, cancel late orders, and provide estimated resolution times via API.
hlg_c12fcb1e0bd72453_001.rationale: llg_001 adds notification to farmers with automatic 20% bonus credit on delays; llg_002 adds notification to customers with estimated resolution time; llg_003 adds automatic 20% bonus credit for missing amounts; llg_004 adds order cancellation and 20% bonus credit for late deliveries — all via API. These capabilities are materially distinct in actor (farmer vs. customer), action (notify vs. cancel vs. credit), and outcome (bonus vs. resolution time vs. cancellation), and none can be generalized or omitted without losing scope.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Automatically credit back missing amount with bonus
Cancel orders and credit wallets with 20% bonus if deliveries are late

hlg_54413bcf2604b197_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Record transactions and enforce payment, enforce pickup forfeit policies, update fair-play scores based on pickup forfeiture, apply fair-play scoring for order prioritization during shortages, and manage forfeited order penalties or bonuses via API.
hlg_54413bcf2604b197_001.rationale: llg_001 adds transaction recording and payment enforcement; llg_002 adds enforcement of pickup forfeit policies including wallet deductions; llg_003 adds automatic fair-play score updates triggered by missed pickups; llg_004 adds fair-play score-based prioritization during shortages; llg_005 adds penalty or bonus management for forfeited orders based on delivery status and behavior. All five capabilities are distinct and must be preserved as they represent different lifecycle phases and outcomes.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Update fair-play score based on pickup forfeiture
Apply fair-play scoring for order prioritization during shortages
Manage forfeited order penalties or bonuses

hlg_8cc6881ea295c041_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable authorized group representatives to submit purchase orders while ensuring their identity is verified before submission.
hlg_8cc6881ea295c041_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the purchasing group representative to submit orders using unique credentials or group ID, establishing the authorization mechanism. llg_002 ensures that before submission, the system verifies the representative’s identity via two-factor authentication or group approval workflow, adding a mandatory verification step. Together, they define a secure, identity-verified order submission process for authorized representatives.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Authorize group representative to submit orders

decisions.rationale: Transparent and traceable product sourcing is documented.
Efficient order management and allocation is documented.
Seamless payment and wallet management is documented.
Product pickup scheduling and collection is documented.
Accurate inventory and availability tracking for farmers is documented.
Fair and transparent allocation during shortages is documented.
Efficient store operations and order fulfillment are documented.
Timely delivery and customer notification for farmers is documented.
Reliable and fair transactional fulfillment is documented.
Group-based purchasing and representative authorization is documented.

The goal 'Ensure transparent and traceable product sourcing' is documented in the project description, aligning with the system's purpose of supporting a conscious purchasing process based on detailed information about products.

The goal 'Support efficient order management and allocation' is documented in the project description, as evidenced by the system's handling of customer orders, minimum quantity constraints, and prioritization based on fair-play scores during shortages.

The goal 'Enable seamless payment and wallet management' is documented in the project description, as reflected in the system's features allowing customers to manage virtual wallets, receive payment notifications, handle insufficient funds with grace periods, and recharge wallets.

The goal 'Optimize product pickup scheduling and collection' is documented in the project description, evident in the system's provision of time slots for product collection, reminders for missed pickups, and enforcement of forfeit policies.

The goal 'Maintain accurate inventory and availability tracking' is documented in the project description, as farmers are required to submit product availability estimates which the system uses for dynamic allocation and order fulfillment.

The goal 'Support fair and transparent allocation during shortages' is documented in the project description, as the system uses a fair-play score system to prioritize customers during product shortages.

The goal 'Enable efficient store operations and order fulfillment' is documented in the project description, as reflected in the system's features allowing store employees to manage orders, coordinate pickups, handle payments, and confirm delivery status.

The goal 'Provide timely delivery and customer notification' is documented in the project description, as evidenced by the system's alerting of stakeholders to delivery delays, automatic crediting of missing amounts with a bonus, and maintenance of transparency about delivery status.

The goal 'Ensure reliable and fair transactional fulfillment' is documented in the project description, as reflected in the system's enforcement of payment and pickup obligations, application of fair-play scoring for order prioritization during shortages, and management of forfeited orders with penalties or bonuses.

The goal 'Support group-based purchasing and representative authorization' is documented in the project description, as only registered representatives of purchasing groups are authorized to submit orders.
